title: Amagansett Indian Well
summary: Amagansett Indian Well is connected with the Amagansett placename and the Indian Well plain in East Hampton.
address_label: Amagansett Indian Well / Indian Well Beach area, East Hampton, NY
ancestral_territory_note: Shown in relation to Montaukett Ancestral Land on the current ancestral territory map.
why_this_matters: Amagansett Indian Well connects a familiar East Hampton placename to Native knowledge of water, fishing places, and coastal life on the East End. The recorded spellings show how a Native name moved through colonial documents while still preserving a relationship between people, plain, well, and shore. Everyday place names can carry Indigenous geography and memory into the present.
translation_content: Recorded forms include Amogonset, Amegansit, Amagansick, Amiganset, Amegonset, and Ammagansit. The name is interpreted Amagansett as referring to the neighborhood of the drinking thing or well, while treating the Indian well as central to the name.
whereintheworld_content: Amagansett shows how a modern village name, a beach name, and an older well-place can carry the same place history. The Indian well context connects everyday East Hampton geography with Montaukett and broader Indigenous Long Island place memory.
